definition.name: Workplace Pension Savings
definition.description: An employee's way through the pension savings plan Valoria Life runs for Kestrel Engineering: the invitation in the HR portal, advice, the questionnaire and the risk profile, the choice of funds, the subscription with its due diligence, the 30 days to cancel, a year of payroll contributions and self-service, the year-end tax certificate, and the annual review.

stages.name: Invitation
stages.description: The employer opens the plan; the employee is invited in the HR portal and by e-mail, and reminded.

stages.name: Discovery and advice
stages.description: The AI adviser explains the plan, the tax ceiling and the risks; a licensed adviser takes over by video call on request.

stages.name: Needs and profile
stages.description: The questionnaire: demands and needs, knowledge and experience, capacity for loss, horizon, risk tolerance, sustainability preferences; the risk profile.

stages.name: Investments
stages.description: A model portfolio or the employee's own choice of unit-linked funds, each with its key information document, checked against the profile.

stages.name: Subscription
stages.description: Identity, anti-money-laundering and tax residence checks, the beneficiary clause, the payroll mandate, the e-signature.

stages.name: Cooling-off and issue
stages.description: The policy is issued and the first premium invested; the employee has 30 days to cancel with a full refund.

stages.name: Saving
stages.description: Monthly payroll contributions, switches and top-ups in self-service, quarterly statements.

stages.name: Year-end tax
stages.description: The deductible amount, a top-up proposed before 31 December, the tax certificate in January for the tax return.

stages.name: Annual review
stages.description: Recommendations: rebalance, reduce the risk with age, update the beneficiary clause after a life event.
